documents.title: Radke–Mabbitt feud during prison
documents.summary: While Radke was in prison, tension with Mabbitt escalated through live shows and social media, including a notorious Warped Tour heckle exchange.

documents.title: FIR at Rock im Park 2014
documents.summary: Falling in Reverse performed at Rock im Park 2014; Radke appeared with the band during that festival cycle.

documents.title: FIR albums — Billboard top 40 streak
documents.summary: Falling in Reverse's first two albums reached the U.S. top 20, and all four studio albums through that point had charted in the top 40.

documents.title: Solo single “Fair-Weather Fans” & YouTube channel
documents.summary: On May 31, 2013, Radke launched his YouTube channel and released the solo song "Fair-Weather Fans," described as a message to people who did not believe in him. He followed with "What Up Earth?" the next day.

documents.title: Rap mixtape plans (Alternative Press)
documents.summary: In an Alternative Press interview, Radke said he was working on a free rap mixtape produced by Charles Massabo (Kallaghan Records), planned for December 2013, with guest features from established rap artists.

documents.title: Rap mixtape in progress (Loudwire)
documents.summary: Radke told Loudwire he was still developing a rap mixtape, continuing the solo era plans he had discussed in earlier interviews.

documents.title: Radke & Jacoby Shaddix headlines
documents.summary: Radke drew press coverage—including from Loudwire—after public back-and-forth with Papa Roach frontman Jacoby Shaddix.

documents.title: Daughter & engagement with Crissy Henderson
documents.summary: Radke has a daughter from his relationship with model Crissy Henderson. He was engaged to Henderson at one point; the couple later separated.

documents.title: Death of brother Anthony (2013)
documents.summary: Radke's older brother Anthony died in a traffic collision in 2013.

documents.title: Memoir I Can Explain published
documents.summary: In December 2022, Radke published the memoir I Can Explain with journalist Ryan J. Downey.

documents.title: Denied UK entry (2024 tour)
documents.summary: In December 2024, Radke was denied entry to the United Kingdom because of his prior prison sentence, which affected Falling in Reverse tour plans.

documents.title: Diss track “I Wash Cars” (Sumerian feud)
documents.summary: A diss track titled "I Wash Cars" leaked online, targeting Sumerian Records, founder Ash Avildsen, Lorenzo "The Main Event" Antonucci, and I See Stars. Avildsen and Antonucci replied with "When Ronnie Met Sally." The feud was later resolved and Radke said the two sides were on good terms again.
